messages.text: Where is my order? Order # Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Tom, your BC04 on Shop···· shipped October 21 and is on its way, tracking ····: (tracking link hidden)

It was due October 24 and the carrier has not logged delivery yet. Has it turned up at (address hidden)? If not, tell me and I'll open a lost-parcel check on it today.
Handed to the team · Carrier logged DeliveryAttemptFailed, parcel undelivered past its Oct 24 estimat

Thanks, Tom. The carrier logged a failed delivery attempt on that parcel, so it is sitting with them rather than with you. That needs tracing with the carrier, and I've put it in front of the team now so they can chase it and get the BC04 to you.

Stay in the chat if you can and one of them will come in here; if you step away, the answer comes to your email.
I can stay a bit longer.

Good. While you wait, one thing worth checking: a failed attempt usually means a card or a notice was left, or the parcel is being held at the local depot for pickup. If anything like that has turned up at Manchester, tell me and I'll pass it straight on.

Anything else on your other orders you want me to look at in the meantime?
I don’t recall getting a notice.

Understood, and that's noted on the ticket for them. No notice plus a failed attempt usually means the parcel is sitting at the depot or went to the wrong address, which is exactly what the team traces with the carrier.

Nothing more is needed from you on it. They're picking it up now and will come back here, or by email if you've stepped away.
